definitions.explanation: A favorable time or situation for doing something.

examples.japanese: チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}さない→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧。
examples.notes: チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ = to miss a chance

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I got the opportunity to work overseas.

notes:
チャンス comes from English "chance" but is used primarily in the sense of "opportunity" rather than probability or luck.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかむ→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧: to seize a chance
- チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss a chance
- チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give a chance
- チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to make the most of a chance
- チャンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait for a chance
- ⟦{絶好|ぜっこう}→絶好：13873_zekkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧チャンス: a golden opportunity
- ⟦ラスト→ラスト：30487_rasuto⟧チャンス: last chance

VS. ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧:
- チャンス: opportunity (casual, positive nuance — implies favorable timing)
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: opportunity (formal, neutral — used in speeches, writing, business)
